functional_requirements: Provide a flat rectangular mounting surface 80 mm x 40 mm x 5 mm
Provide two 10 mm diameter through-holes for fasteners, one near each short edge
Holes must be located 10 mm (centre distance) from each short edge, i.e. at X = +/-30 mm
Hole pattern must be symmetric about both the XZ and YZ centre planes so the plate can be mounted without orientation ambiguity
Flat bottom face (Z=0) must remain fully planar for seating against a mating surface
special_features: Two 10 mm diameter through-holes MUST be created, positioned at X = +HOLE_POS_X (+30 mm) and X = -HOLE_POS_X (-30 mm), i.e. HOLE_OFFSET_FROM_EDGE (10 mm) from each short edge at X = +/-EDGE_X.
Both holes MUST be centred on the mid-width line Y = HOLE_POS_Y = 0, symmetric about the XZ plane.
Both holes MUST be symmetric about the YZ plane (X = 0) — the hole pattern is mirror-symmetric in X.
Holes MUST be through-holes penetrating the full THICKNESS_Z along the Z axis (subtract a cylinder whose height equals THICKNESS_Z), NOT blind holes and NOT aligned along the X or Y axis.
Hole axes MUST be parallel to the global Z axis and normal to both the top (Z = PLATE_TOP_Z) and bottom (Z = PLATE_BOTTOM_Z) plate faces.

Each hole MUST be fully contained within the plate footprint — the hole edges MUST NOT break or intersect the outer boundary of the plate (minimum material of HOLE_OFFSET_FROM_EDGE minus HOLE_RADIUS = 5 mm remains between each hole and its nearest short edge).
After both hole subtractions the part MUST remain a single connected solid (no hole may merge with an outer face to split the body).
The plate MUST NOT include countersinks, chamfers, fillets, bosses, ribs or any additional features beyond the rectangular block and the two through-holes.
